[51, 67]

There is a $\mathbb{Q}(v)$ -algebra isomorphism $\Phi:{}^{\mathrm{Dr}}\widetilde{\textbf{U}}^{\imath}\to\widetilde{\textbf{U}}^{\imath}$, which sends

$\displaystyle B_{i,k}\mapsto B_{i,k},\quad H_{i,m}\mapsto H_{i,m},\quad\Theta_{i,m}\mapsto\Theta_{i,m},\quad\mathbb{K}_{i}\mapsto\mathbb{K}_{i},\quad C\mapsto\mathbb{K}_{\delta},$

for $i\in\mathbb{I}_{0},k\in{\mathbb{Z}},m\geq 1$.
card.label: Theorem 8.1

paper.title: Quantum symmetric pairs
paper.abstract: This is a survey of some recent progress on quantum symmetric pairs and applications. The topics include quasi K-matrices, $\imath$Schur duality, canonical bases, super Kazhdan-Lusztig theory, $\imath$Hall algebras, current presentations for affine $\imath$quantum groups, and braid group actions.
